## Deck Goal
Teach frontend-oriented AEM developers how editable templates define the authoring contract for pages, while separating template type, structure, initial content, policy and page-owned content by lifecycle.

## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "source_summary": "Class 6 of a seven-week AEM Sites course, delivered Monday, August 24, 2026. The audience already understands JCR Resources, repository boundaries and Sling request resolution. This class begins Week 2 and prepares the individual Guide Page authoring practice.",
    "core_claim": "A reliable AEM authoring contract places shared structure, creation-time defaults, design policy and page-owned content in different repository branches according to ownership and synchronization behavior.",
    "canonical_facts": [
      "Page content lives below /content and a page jcr:content Resource can store both cq:template and sling:resourceType.",
      "cq:template records the editable template; sling:resourceType selects the page component used for rendering.",
      "A template type is copied when an editable template is created; the remaining reference is informational rather than dynamic inheritance.",
      "Editable template definitions live below /conf/<site>/settings/wcm/templates.",
      "Structure changes remain connected to pages created from the template.",
      "Initial content is copied when a page is created and later initial-content changes do not update existing pages.",
      "Policies define design and authoring rules and are explored in Day 7."
    ],
    "canonical_terms": [
      "cq:template",
      "sling:resourceType",
      "template type",
      "editable template",
      "structure",
      "initial content",
      "content policy",
      "page component",
      "/conf",
      "/content",
      "/apps"
    ]
  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "Both properties belong on the selected page jcr:content Resource. The template definition is under /conf. The page component implementation resolves under /apps through Sling search paths."
  }
}

  "color_palette": "Warm ivory drafting-paper background, deep navy typography, faint square grid, blue for page and authored content, green for template/configuration, violet for lifecycle and code, restrained orange for warnings.",
  "typography": "Large bold modern sans serif headings; crisp sans serif body copy; true monospace appearance for paths, properties, node names, types and values.",
  "texture_and_finish": "Flat 2D technical diagrams with fine rules, precise repository, page, template, lock and copy icons. No gradients, neon, glass, 3D or photography.",
  "deck_consistency": "Match the approved sample's palette, typography, grid, density, semantic colors, evidence tags and line weight while varying composition by slide role."
}
